# AWS long-tail services

<!-- Generated by `go test ./internal/aws/generic -run Coverage -update`; do not edit. -->

pogi builds these AWS services from the API model AWS publishes for each one, as shipped in botocore (the Python SDK). The code is in `internal/aws/generic`.
For each service, the test picks its main resource, guessing from the operation names. It builds the smallest valid input from the
model's required fields, then sends create, get, list and delete as raw HTTP requests in the service's own wire format. It checks that no response is a
server error, that the new resource appears in the list, and that a get after the delete says not found. Hand-written overrides
are part of the run, so the table shows what a client gets today, not what the model alone gives. Some of these services
also have their own row on [Coverage](coverage.md), so this table is longer than the long-tail row on that page.

118 services: 101 pass, 4 overridden (validated by their own tests), 0 fail, 13 where the test found no resource to drive ("no inferable resource").
